repos_data.description: A graph node engine and editor written in Javascript similar to PD or UDK Blueprints, comes with its own editor in HTML5 Canvas2D. The engine can run client side or server side using Node. It allows to export graphs as JSONs to be included in applications independently.

MCP server for Unreal Engine 5, built into the editor. AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex create and edit Blueprints, materials, levels, Niagara, animation, UMG, PCG, Sequencer, GAS and Behavior Trees, with every change checked and read back.
